o: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

eps.o: A few years after Ted leaves Richmond, some familiar faces visit him in Kansas...or is it Missouri?
Ted returns to Richmond to meet the Lady Greyhounds, but not everyone is glad to see him.
Richmond's shareholders are unsure about a women's team. The coaches hold tryouts to fill out their roster.
The coaches must figure out how to break up team cliques. Ted adjusts to life outside the locker room.
The ladies face off against Chelsea. Alice feels the pressure. Rebecca navigates a complicated dynamic.
It's New Year's Eve! The team celebrates big. Rebecca, Roy, and Keeley ring it in with an old friend.
Alice and Ted try stepping outside their comfort zones. Zelda helps with a new problem at Richmond.
The Lady Greyhounds navigate a difficult setback. Roy and Keeley prepare for the Wall of Legends.
Morale is low, but the stakes have never been higher. Mae joins the team on the road. Keeley has news.
